instruction: In convert-to-title the loop feeds n straight to quotient/remainder. Wrap n in (- n 1) so the numbering is one-based.
input:
(define (convert-to-title column-num)
  (list->string
    (let loop ([n column-num] [title '()])
      (if (zero? n)
          title
          (let-values ([(q r) (quotient/remainder n 26)])
            (loop q (cons (integer->char (+ r 65))
                          title)))))))
expected:
(define (convert-to-title column-num)
  (list->string
    (let loop ([n column-num] [title '()])
      (if (zero? n)
          title
          (let-values ([(q r) (quotient/remainder (- n 1) 26)])
            (loop q (cons (integer->char (+ r 65))
                          title)))))))
